ai_review.summary: High‑quality matrix capture of a stellar 1970 Fillmore West show with intimate acoustic moments and a soaring 'All Over Now Baby Blue'.
ai_review.review: The dusborne matrix fills the gaps left by the soundboard, delivering a clear, home‑y feel that lets listeners sit right in the audience for both the acoustic and electric sets. Reviewers rave about standout performances of "Swing Low Sweet Chariot," "Attics of My Life" and especially a powerful version of "All Over Now Baby Blue," while noting the drum‑driven transitions add extra excitement. Overall the recording is praised as one of the best sources for this 1970 run.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive (average 4.7 stars) and highlight both superb musical performance and a clean matrix recording, giving the show high merit with only minor technical commentary.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blend compensates for missing soundboard sections, especially in the acoustic set; reviewers describe it as clear, intimate and free of major drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set feels like a living‑room jam, followed by an electric half with seamless drum‑driven transitions (e.g., St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > Midnight Hour) that keep the energy high.
